Made by D. S. L. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer
i/c Special Branch the duplicate copies of the "Tung Auh Jih
Pao" in possession of Mr. Tseng Chi Feng (程紀風), legal
advisor to the Public Safety Bureau, were obtained and the
more objectionable articles contained therein translated.
They are similar in nature to those already reported upon
and in the opinion of the undersigned do not constitute
"Communist Propaganda".
Mr. Tseng Chi Feng was asked if the Public Safety
Bureau had any further evidence to offer in substantiation
of the arrest of Tsang Ling, he stated he could only offer
the copies of the Tung Auh Jih Pao, to which reference has
already been made. The origin of these papers is obscure,
they, however, were certainly not found in the possession of
Tsang Ling.

D. S. L.

What Mr Tseng has to offer to
Court does not constitute a charge
against the prisoner. Under the
circumstances & if no further evidence
is forthcoming from the P.S.B. the
SMP must oppose any application
for extradition

agree with these views!

Issue No.4 dated 18/8/32.

The statement of a female member of the Communist
Army regarding the conditions in "Red" districts

The Min Pao, Chinese newspaper, published in
Hankow, carried a report as follows:-
Very little is known of the conditions in
"Red" districts in North Hupeh. Chu Wei Ping (朱衛冰),
the civil commissioner, inspected various hsiens and arrest-
ed a female communist. She stated that all persons male
and female had to work; the men are assigned to sentry
and defence work while the females are set washing and
sewing tasks. All the rich peasants were put under
surveillance and were at executed in the event of dis-
obedience. The land was confiscated and equally divided.
Each physically fit male and female was permitted 3 mow of
land. The aged and young, as well as those could not
work had to report themselves to the Soviet Government
and surrender their land to the public. In the event
of a rise famine the Soviet Government distributed to the
people food from the communal granary. Members of the
Red Army were also given land and when their families
were not in a position to till it, the Soviet Government
assigned persons to cultivate it for them.

Wong Tung Yuen speaks of the circumstances surrounding
the organization of the Red Army

"Changsha" - Wong Tung Yuan, Commander of
the 15th Division on his return to the Province, spoke
to our reporter on the circumstances surrounding the
organization of the Red Army. He stated that among the
Communist Armies, the "Red Army" is comparatively
stronger in fighting, while the "Red Guard", "Guerilla
Groups", etc. are of less importance. The political
workers play the most active part in the Army. There
are no officers and privates in the Communist Army;
they are called "Directors" and "fighters". No such
name as "company" or "corps" is used, they are called
"Tao Shih Tan Wei", in which is established the "Lenin
Room", (Club,) etc.

Issue No.18 dated 1/9/32

The Japanese Newspaper States that the Communist Army
has seized the South Line

Japanese Nippo - translated by Wei Tze Kee.
Our reporter called upon a certain Japanese
immigrant who travelled recently in Hupeh, Honan, and
Shansi. The latter said that the Communist Army was
strong in Hupeh. All areas from Yu Shan Hsien to
Huangpi and from Hsiao Kan to Ehien Hsien, Shansi etc.
are being held by the Red Army. The Communists have
seized the South Line. The Government troops have
retreated to the North. The Communist Army has
established a Soviet Government in the occupied areas.
They have distributed land to the peasants and have
abolished all taxes. The people are generally in favour
of the Communists. The Government troops are demoralized
and are unable to resist the Communist advance. The
Communists are well supplied with arms and ammunition
which they have captured from the Government troops.
The situation is very serious and the Government is
doing its best to suppress the Communist rebellion.

一名共产党女成员关于“赤色”地区状况的陈述

汉口出版的中文报纸《民报》刊登了一则报道如下：
人们对湖北北部“赤色”地区的状况知之甚少。民政专员朱卫冰（Chu Wei Ping）视察了各县，并逮捕了一名女共产党员。她称，所有男女都必须劳动；男子被分配担任哨兵和防御工作，而女子则被安排洗衣和缝纫任务。所有富农都受到监视，一旦不服从即被处决。土地被没收并平均分配。每个身体健全的男女允许拥有3亩土地。老人、儿童以及无法劳动者必须向苏维埃政府报到，并将土地交公。一旦发生饥荒，苏维埃政府会从公共粮仓向民众分发食物。红军成员也分得土地，当其家人无力耕种时，苏维埃政府会指派人员代为耕种。

Wong Tung Yuen 谈红军组建情况

“长沙”——第15师师长 Wong Tung Yuan 返回本省后，向记者讲述了红军组建的相关情况。他指出，在共产党军队中，“红军”战斗力相对较强，而“赤卫队”、“游击队”等则次要得多。政治工作人员在军队中发挥最积极的作用。共产党军队中没有军官和士兵之分；他们被称为“指导员”和“战斗员”。不使用“连”或“军”这类名称，而是称为“导师单位”（Tao Shih Tan Wei），其中设立“列宁室”（俱乐部）等。

第18期，日期1932年9月1日

日本报纸称共产党军队已占领南线

日本《日日新闻》——由 Wei Tze Kee 翻译。
本报记者拜访了一位近期在湖北、河南和山西旅行的日本侨民。后者表示，共产党军队在湖北势力强大。从虞山县到黄陂，以及从孝感到鄂县、山西等地，均由红军控制。共产党人已占领南线。政府军已撤退至北方。共产党军队在占领区建立了苏维埃政府。他们向农民分配土地，并废除了一切税赋。民众普遍支持共产党。政府军士气低落，无法抵抗共产党的推进。共产党拥有充足的武器弹药，这些均是从政府军手中缴获的。局势非常严峻，政府正尽力镇压共产党叛乱。

page_data.en:
Issue No.35 dated 18/9/32.

The policy of the Chinese Government (to deal with the
National Crisis) following the "September 18" incident

In a word, the Principal policies of the Govern-
ment following **〔此处转录不清〕** "September 18" are "non-resistance",
dependance upon the League of Nations", "Suppression
of the Anti-Japanese boycott", "Prohibition of the boycott
movement", and "Suppression of the Communists". These
policies gave rise to the loss of Manchuria, the sale of
Shanghai, the giving away of Jehol and Mongolia and the
creation of danger at Peking and Tientsin. Shanghai and
Nanking will be bombarded and the whole China will be
divided among the Imperialists. The Party and the Government
members are acting as "high officials" and the Japanese
military officers are drinking Champagne, while the Chinese
masses are shedding blood and become friends of hunger and
death.

The conditions at Jehol and Shanghai become more serious follow-
ing the "September 18" Anniversary.

We have related already that the invasion by
the Japanese Imperialists into the Eastern Three Provinces
has the consent and support of the Powers. Apart from
changing China into a colony and thereafter oppressing
the Chinese mass in a more cruel manner, in **〔此处转录不清〕** order so
they say, to spare them from their Economical Crisis,
they directly came and oppressed the anti-Japanese,
anti-Imperialist and revolutionary movements of the Chinese
masses with a view to making the Chinese slaves for good,
as well as to establishing a base in the East for attacking
the Soviet Government. Therefore the bombardment of Jehol
and Shanghai means the development of the plan of the Imperial-
ists to divide China and **〔此处转录不清〕** give the capitalistic nations
a foot hold in the east to enable them to attack the Soviet
Government. This is the scheme of Japan and the Powers
of the world, and not at all accident.

Issue No.54 dated 17/10/32

Two kinds of laws

In former days, the minority (monarchs)
made the law while the majority were ordered to obey. So
law at that time which was merely orders of the monarchs,
contained nothing other than punishment of death.
Following the invention and development of machinery,
law transforms itself into a guard of the 'Private owned
property system' and is employed to oppress the poor
proletarians and farmers who oppose the interest of the
capitalist class. In this age of electricity comes
Socialism which will certainly take over the position
of the Capitalism in the long run. Socialism ignores
the 'private owned property system' and will have a kind
of new law of its own on which a 'brilliant' society will
be built. At present Soviet Russia is the only one who
has such a kind of law.

第35期，日期1932年9月18日。

“九一八”事变后中国政府（应对民族危机）的政策

简而言之，政府在**〔此处转录不清〕**“九一八”事变后的主要政策是“不抵抗”、“依赖国际联盟”、“压制抗日抵制运动”、“禁止抵制运动”以及“镇压共产党”。这些政策导致了满洲的丧失、上海的出卖、热河和蒙古的拱手相让，以及北京和天津面临的危险。上海和南京将遭到轰炸，整个中国将被帝国主义列强瓜分。党和政府成员充当“高官”，日本军官喝着香槟，而中国民众则在流血，成为饥饿和死亡的伙伴。

“九一八”周年纪念日后，热河和上海的局势变得更加严峻。

我们此前已述及，日本帝国主义入侵东三省得到了列强的默许和支持。除了将中国变为殖民地并随后以更残酷的方式压迫中国民众外，据他们说，为了使他们摆脱经济危机，他们直接前来压迫中国民众的反日、反帝和革命运动，旨在使中国人永远沦为奴隶，并在东方建立攻击苏维埃政府的基地。因此，轰炸热河和上海意味着帝国主义列强瓜分中国计划的推进，并**〔此处转录不清〕**使资本主义国家在东方获得立足点，以便它们攻击苏维埃政府。这是日本和世界列强的阴谋，绝非偶然。

第54期，日期1932年10月17日

两种法律

过去，少数人（君主）制定法律，而多数人被迫服从。因此，当时的法律仅仅是君主的命令，除了死刑惩罚外别无他物。
随着机器的发明和发展，法律转变为“私有财产制度”的守护者，并被用来压迫反对资产阶级利益的贫穷无产阶级和农民。在这个电气时代，社会主义应运而生，从长远来看必将取代资本主义的地位。社会主义无视“私有财产制度”，并将拥有一种属于自己的新法律，在此基础上建立“辉煌”的社会。目前，苏维埃俄国是唯一拥有此类法律的国家。

Several foolish questions in connection with law

Question 1. Are those who were originally the promoters
of the Chinese Communist Party, or those who
joined the Communist, offenders? If both
classes are offenders, why are so many persons
who advocated the organization of or joined
the communist party, allowed to serve as
prominent officers in the present Government?

Question 2. If Communism was not an offence prior to
the split between the Kuomintang and Communist
Party why were so many Communist Party members
killed when the change of point-of-view took
place?

Question 3. If we say those who were communists under
the Canton and Wuhan Governments were
offenders, then should the Kuomintang members
who cooperated with the offenders not share this
same guilt?

Question 4. Why were some of the Communist Party members
allowed to go free whilst others were
murdered?

When China was friendly with Soviet Russia, Russia
was the advisor and instructor in China's anti-Imperialists
Campaign but deserted when the campaign weakened.
When Japanese Imperialists invaded China, rumours were
fabricated to the effect that relations would be resumed
with Soviet Russia with the idea of threatening the powers
of the world and of intensifying the high anti-imperialist
spirit of the people. To what extent should the Government
be held responsible in connection with the loss of life
and property which has occurred as the result of their
unsettled policy?

关于法律的几个愚蠢问题

问题1. 最初发起中国共产党的人，或是加入共产党的人，是罪犯吗？如果这两类人都是罪犯，为什么许多主张组织或加入共产党的人，如今却能在现政府中担任显要职务？

问题2. 如果在国民党与共产党分裂之前共产主义并非罪行，那么在观点转变时，为何有如此多的共产党员被杀害？

问题3. 如果我们说在广州和武汉政府时期身为共产党员的人是罪犯，那么与这些罪犯合作的国民党成员难道不应分担同样的罪责吗？

问题4. 为什么有些共产党员被释放，而另一些却被杀害？

当中国与苏维埃俄国友好时，俄国是中国反帝运动的顾问和指导者，但在运动减弱时便抛弃了中国。当日本帝国主义入侵中国时，有人制造谣言称将与苏维埃俄国恢复关系，意在威胁世界列强并激发民众高昂的反帝精神。对于因其政策不定而导致的人员伤亡和财产损失，政府应承担多大责任？

---

Made by and Forwarded by C. D. I. Prince

Sir,

So far as can be ascertained the man Tsang Ling (張林)
assistant editor of the mosquito newspaper "Tung Auh Jih Pao"
(東亞日報) has no connection with any other newspaper or peri-
odical. The articles appearing in the above paper were usually
news items, open criticisms of activities of members of the
National Government, and anti-Communist and Bandit Suppression
activities, most of which articles were reproduced from other
Chinese and Japanese press-organs.

Copies of translations of articles which appeared in the
"Tung Auh Jih Pao" are submitted herewith.

I also attach a translation of an article, relating to
Lieu Ching Yuen (劉鏡園) the former Editor-in-Chief of the
Tung Auh Jih Pao, which appeared in the "Social News" (社會新聞)
on November 12, 1932.

C. D. I.

MUTINY OF SOLDIERS IN CHEKIANG.

According to reliable sources, the Peace

months in arrears. The Hsien Magistrate and other high

The mutineers have decided to join to the

YINCHOW CAPTURED BY COMMUNIST ARMY.

Yinchow, an important town on the upper Chitang

The 19th Route Army, apart from rounding-up

welcomed the arrival of the 19th Route Army, are extremely
disappointed and sorrowful.

THE BLUE JACKET CORPS SUGGESTS MANCHURIA BE GIVEN TO JAPAN.

A Nanking telegram appeared in the Mainichi, a Japanese paper,

September 15 was the date of the recognition

order. No untoward incidents occurred. The Blue Jacket

lines of propaganda for the anniversary of the September 18

"The armed forces of China are far worse than

action at this time when civil wars are going on in the country.
The Communist armies in China must first be suppressed.
"China should adopt the following policy:-
1) For the time being China should give Manchuria

DETAILS OF THE FALL OF PUCHEN CITY TO COMMUNIST ARMY.

The Tung Ah Jih Pao (東亞日报), a mosquito paper,
published the following article under the above heading on
October 3:-
(Jih Jih Zou):-

On September 13th, Fang Chih Min of the Communist
Army joined the local Communists who number over 6,000 men
with 3,000 rifles. They capture Chi Shek, a place about
twenty li from Chung An. Telegraphic communications were out
off. Puchen City declared special martial law on the 16th.
On the 18th, a regiment was dispatched to meet the approaching
Communists some forty li from Puchen City. The Communists
made a furious attack on the regiment and succeeded in
surrounding it. After a day of desperate fighting, the
regiment was scattered and defeated. At about 5 p.m. on the
19th, the Communists launched a sudden attack on the city
walls. The peace maintenance corps and the police of the
city (about 300 men) resisted strongly. The dauntless attackers
used trench motors, heavy machine guns, siege guns etc. and
heavily bombarded the city for one night. The Great West
Gate was smashed in the morning.

At 3 p.m. in the afternoon, reinforcements of
one Government regiment from Nanshian arrived and engaged
the Communists in Sui Nan district about two li from the city.
The Communists withdrew the force attacking the North Gate
to help their comrades at Sui Nan. The Government regiment
was repelled while another Government regiment north of the
city was cut off from the city.

After 6 p.m. the Great West Gate was forced by
the communists and fierce street fighting ensued for about
one hour. The city fell into the hands of the Communists
at 7 p.m. October 20 when the Government soldiers fled away
from the city.

共产党军队攻占浦城 (Puchen) 市的详情。

蚊报《东亚日报》(Tung Ah Jih Pao) 于10月3日以以上标题发表了以下文章：
（日日走）：

9月13日，共产党军队的方志敏 (Fang Chih Min) 与拥有3000支步枪、人数超过6000人的当地共产党人会合。他们攻占了距中安 (Chung An) 约二十里的赤石 (Chi Shek)。电报通讯中断。浦城市于16日宣布特别戒严。18日，一个团被派往距浦城市约四十里处迎击逼近的共产党人。共产党人对该团发动猛烈攻击并成功将其包围。经过一天的殊死战斗，该团溃败。19日下午5点左右，共产党人对城墙发动突然袭击。市保安团和警察（约300人）进行了顽强抵抗。无畏的攻击者使用了战壕迫击炮、重机枪、攻城炮等，对城市轰炸了一整夜。大西门在早晨被攻破。

下午3点，来自南贤 (Nanshian) 的一个政府军团增援部队抵达，并在距城市约两里的遂南 (Sui Nan) 地区与共产党人交战。共产党人撤回了攻击北门的部队以支援遂南的同伴。政府军团被击退，而城以北的另一个政府军团与城市失去联系。

晚上6点后，大西门被共产党人强行突破，随后发生了约一小时的激烈巷战。10月20日晚上7点，随着政府士兵逃离城市，城市落入共产党人手中。

Tung Ah Jih Pao ( 東亞日報 ), a mosquito paper,
published the following article on November :-

DISTURBANCES CREATED BY REFUGEES.

The districts of Shanghai, Kiangwan and Woosung
were seriously damaged by the imperialistic Japanese during
the January 28 Incident. At the outbreak of the Shanghai
hostilities, old and young refugees took shelter in the
Settlement. The deplorable scenes of those days seem still
fresh before our eyes.

It will be recalled that our people raised relief
funds for the refugees while the Chinese and foreign
authorities declared martial law and devised relief measures
for the maintenance of peace and order.

After the Armistice Agreement was signed, refugees
were escorted to their native places but they were unable
to make a living and they could not find food, lodging or
clothing.

How the authorities spent the relief funds
contributed by the enthusiastic people is unknown to us.
Hungry people had - wait for "relief measures" to be adopted
by the authori. . . . d were compelled by their condition
to create disturbances on October 31.

Not only in the district of Kiangwan but also in
the various places under the imperialistic Japanese, the
refugees should endeavour to make a living by means of their
own efforts and with the assistance of fellow countrymen.

蚊报《东亚日报》(Tung Ah Jih Pao) 于11月发表了以下文章：

难民制造的骚乱。

在上海、江湾和吴淞地区，在一·二八事变期间遭受了帝国主义日本的严重破坏。上海战事爆发时，老幼难民涌入租界避难。那些日子里的悲惨景象似乎仍历历在目。

回想当时，我国人民为难民筹集救济资金，而中外当局宣布戒严并制定救济措施以维持治安。

停战协定签署后，难民被护送回原籍，但他们无法谋生，找不到食物、住所或衣物。

当局如何使用热心人士捐赠的救济资金，我们不得而知。饥饿的人们——等待当局采取“救济措施”______ d 被迫因处境所迫于10月31日制造骚乱。

不仅在江湾地区，而且在帝国主义日本控制下的各个地方，难民都应努力通过自身努力并在同胞的帮助下谋生。

propaganda for any individual or party or public body,
and has never received any subsidy from any individual,
party or public body. Our entire capital was raised
by a few shareholders. When commencing our publication,
we applied for registration to the Party and civic organs
as well as the Political Branches of the Shanghai Municipal
Police and French Police.
Everyday we send our news to the Party and civic
organs for censorship and so far we have never been
criticized. On November 4, we received a letter from
the Publicity Department of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai warning us that the publication of the news item
entitled "Yesterday afternoon 3,000 refugees fought the
Police" as well as the news relating to Soviet Russia on
the second page of our paper of that date was a violation
of the Press Law. This article was furnished by the
Jih Jih News Agency (日日通訊社) and has been translated
from the "Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury". It was
also published in other leading newspapers. There was
some slight negligence over the heading of the article,
but it was not a deliberate exaggeration. The articles
published on the second page of our paper are mostly
contributions and do not propagate communism.
Upon receipt of the letter, the editorial staff
of our paper was warned to pay more attention to the
selection of new items.
However, at 4 p.m. yesterday, detectives from
the police station came to our office and conducted a
search. Even scraps of paper were examined, but
nothing of a suspicious character was found. The
Police officers declared that there was no evidence, but
they produced a warrant of arrest stating that their
action had been taken at the instance of the Chinese
Authorities, but they did not state which particular
authority. At that time, the officers of the Chinese
authorities desired the Settlement Police to take four of
our employees to the Station. When asked by the
Settlement Police for evidence, the officers of the
Chinese authorities stated that they had been instructed
to make arrest and that they did not care anything about
evidence. After some discussion, one of our reporters,
named Tsang Ling (張林), was taken to the Station.
We shall continue our work as usual.

杂项

《东亚日报》（Tung Ah Jih Pao），一家小型报刊：

《东亚日报》。

本报于两个月前创刊。自创刊以来，本报从未为任何个人、政党或公共团体进行过宣传，也从未接受任何个人、政党或公共团体的资助。我们的全部资本由少数股东筹集。在开始出版时，我们已向党部及市民团体机关，以及上海公共租界工部局警务处政治部和法租界巡捕房政治部申请注册。
我们每日将新闻送交党部及市民团体机关审查，迄今从未受到批评。11月4日，我们收到大上海市政府宣传处的来信，警告称，本报当日第二版刊登的题为“昨日下午三千难民与警察搏斗”的新闻，以及有关苏俄的新闻，违反了《出版法》。该文章由日日通讯社提供，译自《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury）。其他主要报纸也刊登了此文。文章标题略有疏忽，但并非故意夸大。本报第二版刊登的文章多为投稿，并不宣传共产主义。
收到信件后，本报编辑部已获警示，将在新闻选题上更加注意。
然而，昨日下午4时，警察局侦探来到我社进行搜查。甚至连纸屑都进行了检查，但未发现任何可疑物品。警官宣称没有证据，但他们出示了逮捕令，声称其行动是应中国当局的要求采取的，但未说明具体是哪个当局。当时，中国当局官员要求租界巡捕将我方四名雇员带往警局。当租界巡捕要求出示证据时，中国当局官员表示他们奉命逮捕，不在乎什么证据。经过一番讨论，我方一名记者张林（Tsang Ling）被带往警局。
我们将照常继续工作。

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times publishes the following correspondence from Bingwo:

BRITISH SUBJECTS DETAINED AT BINGWO.

On the afternoon of October 30, a motor boat
arrived at Bingwo. Two British subjects named "Mo-ting"
(麻丁) and "Mc-tish" (馬聽) went ashore with guns and
began to hunt in the fields. While doing so, they
wounded in the neck a male and a female farmer working
in the field. The farmers in the vicinity gathered
and took the two Englishmen, together with their guns,
to the Magistrate's Yamen. A hearing was opened at
which the names and nationality of these two foreigners
were ascertained. They are at present detained in a
room of the officer in charge of the prison. A telegram
has been sent to the provincial government requesting
instructions.

Tung Ah Jih Pao; (東亞日報), a mosquito paper:

DISTURBANCES CREATED BY KIANGWAN REFUGEES.

As the district of Kiangwan was seriously
damaged during the January 28 Incident, the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai has decided to raise funds to
relieve the refugees.. As the Municipality is short
of funds at present, the refugees began to fear that
the Preparatory Committee of the Municipal Administration
had detained the funds. For this reason, at 4 p.m.
yesterday, over 300 refugees approached the Committee
to demand relief funds. They destroyed everything
in the premises and stated that they will create
further disturbances on November 1.
